create_xecguard_config: create an XecGuardConfigModel instance with api_key, policy_names, and grounding_strictness settings
review_xecguard_policies: review the XECGUARD_DEFAULT_POLICY_OPTIONS list to see available built-in policy names for XecGuard
configure_xecguard_api: configure the XecGuardConfigModel api_base and api_key fields to connect to a custom XecGuard endpoint
set_xecguard_blocking: set block_on_error on XecGuardConfigModel to control fail-closed behavior when the API is unreachable
customize_xecguard_grounding: customize grounding_strictness on XecGuardConfigModel to BALANCED or STRICT for context-grounding validation
